item.title: NHS hospital waiting lists hit highest level in nearly a year
item.body: Health Secretary Yvette Cooper has warned that pressures will increase as winter approaches, after NHS hospital waiting lists reached their highest level in nearly a year.

photo.id: wm:Yvette Cooper Official Cabinet Portrait, September 2025 (cropped).jpg

caption:
🔴 BREAKING | 🏥 NHS hospital waiting lists hit highest level in nearly a year

Health Secretary Yvette Cooper has warned that pressures will increase as winter approaches, after NHS hospital waiting lists reached their highest level in nearly a year.

Source: The Independent | Image: Lauren Hurley / No 10 Downing Street / OGL 3, Wikimedia Commons
UK Daily Briefing | 12 November, 11:50
